title: Tamarind BBQ Ribs
description: Tender and fall-off-the-bone ribs slathered in a sweet and tangy tamarind BBQ sauce.

ingredients.name: pork ribs
ingredients.notes: baby back ribs or spare ribs

instructions: Remove the membrane from the back of the ribs.
In a small bowl, mix together the BBQ rub and brown sugar (if using).
Apply the rub evenly to both sides of the ribs.
Place the ribs in a large baking dish and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 2 hours, or until the ribs are tender.
Brush the ribs with tamarind BBQ sauce during the last 10 minutes of cooking.
Remove the ribs from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes.
Cut the ribs into individual portions and serve.
